measurement_note: 13 input-free frames at 3 s intervals, t01 excluded as the pre-render black frame. Band fractions over those frames: newGame 0.2567-0.3241, continue (the LOAD GAME row) 0.2773-0.3197. Two absent controls -- a band below the menu at y 790 and one in the right half at x 1700 -- read 0.0000 on every frame, so absent is exactly zero here as it is on the FNaF 2 build, despite the heavy green static. The static never reaches brightness 150. present_min sits at 0.10 against a measured minimum present of 0.2567, so the floor stands a factor of 2.5 below the dimmest thing it must accept, and is not anchored to the value it protects.
row_geometry_note: Row spans measured from an averaged brightness profile over the 13 frames: newGame 504-554, loadGame 616-666, OPTIONS 954-1004 (its two sub-bands are the top and bottom strokes of the block letters, not two items). The menu is left-aligned; text spans roughly x 200-800, so a 640-wide band centred at x 480 covers all three rows.
options_note: OPTIONS is deliberately not an item. It serves as menu_gate below, matching the FNaF 2 model, which also keeps its Options row as a gate rather than a target. Nothing here is calibrated for tapping Options; a flow that wants it must add and measure its own target.

title_gate.note: the vertical FNAF3 logo at the left edge. Column extent measured at x 256-300 and row extent at y 92-392. Reads 0.4629-0.5130 on the 13 capture frames and 0.5180 on a live title read; 0.0000 on all three Options-screen frames and 0.0000 on the pre-render black frame.

menu_gate.note: the OPTIONS row. Reads 0.2158-0.2411 on the 13 capture frames and 0.2460 on a live title read; 0.0000 on all three Options-screen frames and 0.0000 on the pre-render black frame.

vocabulary_note: FNaF 3 renders this entry as LOAD GAME, not Continue. The model names it `continue` because this project's MenuTarget vocabulary is SEMANTIC rather than label-based -- `continue` means resume the saved night, which is exactly what LOAD GAME does -- and title-observe.py rightly refuses any name outside that set, on the grounds that a model naming something else is a model for a different game build. That refusal is correct and was hit here on the first run. It is also concrete evidence for Plan 26's per-game vocabulary work: FNaF 3 has no sixthNight and no customNight, and FNaF 1's title carries an Unlocks entry with no MenuTarget at all. Until the vocabulary is per-game, a FNaF 1 model cannot be expressed here without the same kind of aliasing, and Unlocks has no honest alias.
gate_validation: VALIDATED 2026-09-20. Two negatives now come from real screens rather than a black frame. (1) Options: one tap on OPTIONS, three captured frames, both gates reading EXACTLY 0.0000 against floors of 0.20 and 0.10. (2) The New Game confirmation dialog, which this model previously listed as its missing measurement and the reason it must not gate a NEW GAME tap. Measured on the live dialog: title_gate 0.4981 (in-band with the 0.4629-0.5130 seen on the title, so the FNAF3 logo persists) and menu_gate EXACTLY 0.0000 (the OPTIONS row is absent). The pair therefore separates the dialog from the menu: title present AND menu absent means NOT A MENU. A flow that gates its taps on menu_gate >= 0.10 correctly refuses here, and this model may now gate a NEW GAME tap.
transition_note: A frame captured 4 s after backing out of Options reads the title gate at roughly 0.15-0.17, against 0.5180 for a settled title. That falls in the undecided band between absent_max and min, and the observer returns `unknown=ambiguous:title-gate` with exit 3 -- it declines to assert either way, which is what the band exists for. An earlier draft of this note called it a false negative; it is not, and the distinction matters: the model is behaving correctly and the caller simply must not treat one post-transition frame as an answer. Settle, or take multi-frame consensus -- the same conclusion FNaF 1's animated title forces, reached from the other direction.
render_settings_note: The Options screen exposes Display Mode (FULL), Perspective Effect (ON) and Controller Size (120%) on this handset. All three plausibly change rendered geometry, and Controller Size most obviously scales the on-screen controls. Any FNaF 3 control map is therefore valid only for a stated combination of these, and they belong in a resolved profile beside the build and the handset. UNKNOWN(not-measured): their actual effect on control positions.
confirmation_dialog_note: The dialog reads 'Start a new game?' with NO above YES. Measured row centres on this handset: prompt (430, 556), NO (257, 641), YES (289, 753). NO sits at y=641 -- the SAME y as this model's `continue` target (480, 641). A stale tap issued at the LOAD GAME position while the dialog is up lands on the NO row's line, so the failure is near-miss rather than obviously wrong, which is exactly why menu_gate has to be checked before the tap rather than after it. Reaching this state erases the save; it was measured with the operator's explicit consent after the FNaF 3 save was deliberately reset to Night 1.
